column1: #  - proc, func, iterator, template, macro and converter are function, at any depth (a nested proc is a named routine); method is method; a forward declaration (a header with no body) counts too;
#  - a backquoted operator is named by its symbol; the export marker * is not part of the name;

#  - in a type section: object, enum, tuple[...], distinct, `ref object` and variant types are class; a concept is interface; every other right-hand side (seq[int], proc type, ptr, ref Foo, int | string) is type_alias;
#  - const NAME is constant, let and var NAME are variable; these and type sections count at the top level and in the branches of a top-level `when`, not inside a routine (those are locals);
#  - fields, enum members and parameters are not definitions.
